# How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol)

The new MCP server feature gives users, partners, and developers a powerful new way to interact with systeme.io using AI tools.

## 1. Introduction to MCP

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that enables AI assistants (such as ChatGPT or Claude) to connect securely to external platforms.

With MCP, you can use natural language commands to interact with your systeme.io data. For example, you can ask ChatGPT to find a contact or add a tag just by typing a sentence.

Our MCP feature currently provides direct access to specific contact-management features, allowing you to use AI to manage your contacts, tags, and contact fields.

Introduction to MCP MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that enables AI assistants (such as ChatGPT or Claude) to connect securely to external platforms. With MCP, you can use natural language commands to interact with your systeme.io data. For example, you can ask ChatGPT to find a contact or add a tag just by typing a sentence. Our MCP feature currently provides direct access to specific contact-management features, allowing you to use AI to manage your contacts, tags, and contact fields. 2. How the systeme.io MCP server works The systeme.io MCP server allows AI applications to access specific contact-management tools within your account. It creates a bridge between: The host : Your AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude). The server: Your systeme.io account. Once connected, the AI can execute commands to manage your contacts and tags automatically. For technical details, please refer to our official MCP documentation: https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server 3. Generating your MCP keys To connect an AI tool, you first need to generate a secure MCP key. Click Settings (1), then select MCP & API keys (2) under Connections in the left-hand menu. Scroll down to the MCP keys section and click Create (3). Give your key a name (4), set an expiration date (5), and click Create (6). Your key is now ready. 4. Connecting your AI tool Once you have generated your MCP keys, follow the specific guide below to connect your preferred AI tool to systeme.io : How to connect ChatGPT to your systeme.io account using MCP keys How to connect Claude to your systeme.io account using MCP keys 5. Using the systeme.io MCP server You can use AI tools to perform the following actions: a. Contact management: Create and update contacts: Add new contacts or update existing ones. Delete contacts: Remove contacts from your list. List and retrieve contacts: Use filters to list contacts or fetch specific contact details. Manage tags: Create, assign, list, and remove tags from contacts. Retrieve contact fields (custom fields): List available contact fields and their identifiers (slugs) so the AI can correctly fill in and update contact information. For more information about contact management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your contacts with the systeme.io MCP server . b. Newsletter and campaign management: Newsletters: Create new drafts, update existing ones, target audiences (using include/exclude tags), configure sender details, schedule or remove scheduling, send test emails, send newsletters directly, delete drafts, and fetch specific newsletters. Campaigns: Create, retrieve, update, and delete entire email campaigns, as well as individual campaign steps. Email statistics: Retrieve performance statistics for your newsletters, campaign emails, and automation emails. You can fetch totals for a specific period (up to 31 days) with a daily breakdown, results for each email sent during that period, or all-time results for a specific email. Statistics include sends, opens, clicks, bounces, and spam reports. For more information about newsletter and email campaign management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your newsletters and email campaigns with the systeme.io MCP server . Note on newsletters and campaigns: Newsletters created via MCP will automatically use the default sender name and email address configured in your account settings. For email campaigns, scheduling and activating campaign steps is not yet supported through MCP and must be managed manually. Retrieving per-recipient details and specific link-click statistics is not currently supported. For sensitive actions like scheduling, sending, or deleting newsletters, the AI will ask for your confirmation before proceeding. c. Funnel management: Create funnels, opt-in steps, and webinar funnels: Use your AI tool to easily create new funnels, add opt-in steps to your funnels, and create webinar funnels with all the necessary webinar steps, including registration, thank you, and webinar broadcast pages. List and retrieve funnels: Browse through your existing funnels, opt-in steps, and webinar pages, or search for specific ones. Regenerate page content (webinar pages): Regenerate the full content of a webinar page. For more information about funnel management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your funnels with the systeme.io MCP server . Notes: Currently, modifying (editing) funnels and funnel steps via MCP is not supported. Deleting funnels, funnel steps, and webinar pages through MCP is also not supported at this time. While AI can regenerate the content of a webinar page, small targeted edits are not currently supported (it can only replace the funnel step's full content). d. Price plan and coupon management: Create, edit, and delete items: Use your AI tool to easily generate new price plans and coupons, or modify and delete existing ones. List and search: Browse through all your existing price plans and coupons, or search for specific items. For more information about price plan and coupon management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your price plans and coupons with the systeme.io MCP server . e. Automation rules and workflows management: Create automation rules: Easily connect common events and actions without configuring them manually in your dashboard. Currently, you can create rules using the following triggers: Tags ( Tag added, Tag removed ), Courses ( Enrolled in course, Course completed, Lecture completed, Module completed ), Sales ( Subscription payment failed, New sale, Sale canceled ), Funnel form subscribed, Campaign completed, Booking created, and Page visited . And the following actions: Tags ( Add a tag, Remove a tag ), Courses ( Enroll in course, Revoke access to course ), Unsubscribe from campaign, Send webhook, and Send SMS . List and retrieve automation rules: Browse your automation rules or fetch a specific rule by its ID. Create and manage workflows: Create, list, activate, and deactivate workflows directly through the chat. Configure workflow steps: Build workflow sequences using the following trigger: Funnel form subscribed , Tag added & Tag removed, Campaign completed, Enrolled in course, Course completed, Lecture completed & Module completed, Subscription payment failed, New sale & Sale canceled, Booking created & Page visited . The following action: Add a tag & Remove tag, Revoke access to cours, Subscribe to campaign & Unsubscribe from campaign, Send webhook, Send email to a specific address & Send SMS . The following delay: Wait until a specific date and time, with timezone support. You can also add YES/NO branches based on tags, registration date, last activity date, or contact status, including whether a contact has made a payment. For more information about automation rules management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your automation rules and workflows with the systeme.io MCP server . f. Digital product management: Create, view, update, and delete: Fully manage your digital products using your AI tool. List and search: Browse your existing digital products or search for specific ones. Link price plans: Create a new digital product and price plan together, or link an existing price plan directly to a digital product. Connect to selling flows: Programmatically connect digital products to your selling flows (order forms, upsells, downsells). For more information about digital product management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your digital products with the systeme.io MCP server. g. Physical product management: Create, view, update, retrieve, and delete: Fully manage your physical products using your AI tool. Connect to selling flows: Easily connect your physical products to selling flows (as order forms, upsells, and downsells). For more information about physical product management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your physical products with the systeme.io MCP server . h. Offers and sales settings management: Create and configure offers: Set up offers for your selling flows, such as order forms, upsells, and downsells. Manage sales settings: Configure detailed settings for your offers, including coupons, order bumps, currency, payment methods, tax settings, affiliate commissions, payout delays, and sales limits. You can also easily attach your digital and physical products directly to these offers. i. Calendar bookings management: Create, update, and delete events: Generate new booking calendar events, or easily modify and delete existing ones. Availability: Adjust when bookings can happen directly through AI by managing Weekly availability, Date-specific availability, and Unavailability periods. List and search events: Retrieve a list of your booking calendar events or search for specific ones by name. Retrieve event details: Fetch full details for a specific event, including its locations, availability, time zone, date range, and reminders. List and filter bookings: Retrieve a list of your calendar bookings and filter them by event, status, and date range. Note on calendar events: Updating an existing calendar event's type is not currently supported through MCP. j. Course management: For more information about calendar booking management using the MCP server, check out our dedicated help article: How to manage your booking calendar with the systeme.io MCP server . j. Course management: Courses: Create, edit settings, delete, list, retrieve, activate, and deactivate courses. List course page templates and choose a theme for your course. Modules: Create, edit, delete, list, and retrieve modules to structure your courses. Lectures: Create, edit, delete, add delays, enable comments, list, retrieve, activate, and deactivate lectures. k. SMS template management: Create, edit, and delete: Generate new SMS templates, or modify and remove existing ones you no longer need. List and search: Retrieve a list of your existing SMS templates or search for specific ones. Notes: For security reasons, MCP keys are valid for a maximum of 90 days . You can create a maximum of two MCP keys at a time. This is an initial release implementation and does not yet support the recommended authentication method (OAuth). So you may experience minor stability issues. OAuth support is currently planned . Once released, it will improve security and eliminate the need for key expiration. Did this answer your question? pages.text: Loading How to manage your price plans and coupons with the systeme.io MCP server | systeme.io Help Center Categories Affiliation Blog Booking calendar Contact management Courses Customer support Deliverability Editor Emails General Migrating to systeme.io Model Context Protocol (MCP) › Payments Sales funnels Categories · Model Context Protocol (MCP) Affiliation Blog Booking calendar Contact management Courses Customer support Deliverability Editor Emails General Migrating to systeme.io Model Context Protocol (MCP) Payments Sales funnels Model Context Protocol (MCP) English Español Français How to manage your price plans and coupons with the systeme.io MCP server In this article, you will learn how to manage your price plans and coupons using natural language through our native MCP server. By connecting an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude, you can easily create, update, and organize your pricing options seamlessly without leaving your chat window. What you will need: A systeme.io account An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ( How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol)) An AI tool connected to your systeme.io account using MCP keys: How to connect your systeme.io account with Claude using MCP keys How to connect your systeme.io account with ChatGPT using MCP keys 1. Managing price plans The MCP server allows you to perform basic actions on your price plans directly from the chat. Just provide the required details (such as name, price, and currency) and specify the action you want to perform. a. Create a price plan: You can ask the AI to generate a new price plan for your offers. Example: Create a monthly subscription price plan named "Marketing automation pro" for $49 per month, using USD as the currency. b. Edit a price plan: If you need to change a price plan's details, you can instruct the AI to update its settings. Example: Update the price plan "Marketing automation pro" and change the name to "Marketing automation premium". c. List and retrieve price plans: You can use the AI to browse through your existing price plans or search for a specific one without navigating your dashboard manually. Example: List all my price plans. Or find the price plan named "eBook". d. Delete a price plan: Instruct the AI to completely remove a price plan from your systeme.io account. Example: Delete the price plan named "Marketing Automation Premium". 2. Managing coupons Coupons are a great way to offer discounts, and you can manage them completely through the AI chat. a. Create a coupon: Tell the AI to create a new coupon by providing the code, discount amount, currency, and expiration date. Example: Create a coupon with these attributes: coupon code FIRSTORDER20, internal name New customer acquisition campaign, discount 20%, currency USD, and expiration date November 29, 2026. b. Edit a coupon: You can easily ask the AI to change an existing coupon's attributes. Example: Update the coupon "FIRSTORDER20" and change the expiration date to November 30, 2026. Note: Once a coupon is created, its discount amount or percentage cannot be changed. c. List and retrieve coupons: You can ask the AI to retrieve and display a list of all your currently existing coupons. Example: List my recent coupons. Or find the coupon with the name "Black Friday". d. Delete a coupon: You can tell the AI to remove a coupon that you no longer need. Example: Delete the coupon with the code "FIRSTORDER20". Notes: You can use the MCP server to link your price plans directly to your digital products. You can also configure offers for your funnel payment pages and automatically attach your price plans and coupons to them. The AI will require confirmation prompts depending on the platform you use (for example, ChatGPT may ask for permission to run the action before creating or deleting an item). By connecting an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude, you can easily create and retrieve simple automation rules to connect common events and actions without configuring them manually in your dashboard. What you will need: A systeme.io account An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ( How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol)) An AI tool connected to your systeme.io account using MCP keys: How to connect your systeme.io account with Claude using MCP keys How to connect your systeme.io account with ChatGPT using MCP keys 1. Managing automation rules The MCP server allows you to perform basic actions on your automation rules directly from the chat. You just need to specify the trigger and the action you want the rule to execute. a. Create an automation rule: You can ask the AI to generate a brand-new automation rule in your account. Currently, the MCP server supports the following specific elements: Triggers: Tags (Tag added, Tag removed), Courses (Enrolled in course, Course completed, Lecture completed, Module completed), Sales (Subscription payment failed, New sale, Sale canceled), Funnel form subscribed, Campaign completed, Booking created, and Page visited. Actions: Tags (Add a tag, Remove a tag), Courses (Enroll in course, Revoke access to course), Emails (Send email, Send email to a specific address, Subscribe to campaign, Unsubscribe from campaign), Send webhook, and Send SMS. Example: Create an automation rule that adds the tag "New Lead" when someone subscribes to the "Summer campaign" funnel form. b. List and retrieve automation rules: You can use the AI to browse through your existing automation rules without having to navigate through your dashboard manually. Example: List my recent automation rules. 2. Managing workflows The MCP server allows you to build, manage, and activate automated workflows directly from the chat. a. Create a workflow: You can ask the AI to generate a workflow and structure its sequence. Currently, the MCP server supports the following specific elements: Triggers : Tags (Tag added, Tag removed), Courses (Enrolled in course, Course completed, Lecture completed, Module completed), Sales (Subscription payment failed, New sale, Sale canceled), Funnel form subscribed, Campaign completed, Booking created, and Page visited. Actions: Tags (Add a tag, Remove a tag), Revoke access to a course, Subscribe to campaign, Unsubscribe from campaign, Send webhook, Send email to a specific address, and Send SMS. Delays: You can instruct the AI to set a waiting period until a specific date and time (with timezone support). Conditions (Decisions): You can split your workflow into YES/NO paths based on Tags, Registration date, Last activity date, or Contact status (including whether they have made a payment). Example: Create a new workflow that triggers when the "Summer campaign" funnel form is subscribed. First, add the tag "New Leads", wait until December 1st at 9:00 AM, and then check if the contact has the tag "Purchased". If yes, remove the "New Lead" tag. b. Activate and deactivate workflows: Workflows are inactive by default when created. You can instruct the AI to instantly turn them on or pause them. Example: Activate my "Summer Campaign Follow-up" workflow. c. List and retrieve workflows: You can use the AI to browse through your existing workflows and view their sequences. Example: List my 3 most recent workflows. Notes: Modifying (editing) and deleting automation rules and workflows are not supported at this time but will be added soon. The AI will require confirmation prompts depending on the platform you use (for example, ChatGPT may ask for permission to run the action before creating a rule). Did this answer your question? The systeme.io MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is a standard that securely connects your systeme.io account to AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude. It allows you to interact with your business data using natural language, enabling you to build funnels, manage contacts, and create email campaigns just by typing simple commands in your chat window. Is it safe to connect my systeme.io account to AI tools? Yes. We prioritize your security by using a secure authentication process. When you connect via MCP, you are in control of the permissions granted to the AI. You can choose which tools the AI can access (read-only vs. write/delete) and revoke that access at any time directly from your AI provider’s settings. Do I need to be a developer to use the MCP server? Not at all. While the MCP standard is built for developers, our direct integration allows you to connect your account to ChatGPT or Claude in just a few clicks. No coding is required; you simply authorize the connection, and you’re ready to start using AI to manage your systeme.io workspace. Can the AI perform any action on my account? You are in control. You can configure permission levels for each tool the AI uses: Always allow, Needs approval, or Blocked. For sensitive operations (like creating or deleting contacts, price plans, or coupons), the AI will require your confirmation within the chat before executing any command. Which systeme.io plans include access to the MCP server? The MCP server is a powerful feature included in all systeme.io plans. Whether you are on our Free, Startup, Webinar, or Unlimited plan, you can connect your account to AI tools and start leveraging the power of natural language to streamline your marketing and business management. pages.text: Loading How to manage your contacts with the systeme.io MCP server | systeme.io Help Center Categories Affiliation Blog Booking calendar Contact management Courses Customer support Deliverability Editor Emails General Migrating to systeme.io Model Context Protocol (MCP) › Payments Sales funnels Categories · Model Context Protocol (MCP) Affiliation Blog Booking calendar Contact management Courses Customer support Deliverability Editor Emails General Migrating to systeme.io Model Context Protocol (MCP) Payments Sales funnels Model Context Protocol (MCP) English Deutsch Español Français 日本語 Português How to manage your contacts with the systeme.io MCP server In this article, you will learn how to manage your systeme.io contacts using natural language through our native MCP server. By connecting an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude, you can add, update, and organize your contacts seamlessly without leaving your chat window. What you will need: A systeme.io account An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ( How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protocol)) An AI tool connected to your systeme.io account using MCP keys: How to connect your systeme.io account with Claude using MCP keys How to connect your systeme.io account with ChatGPT using MCP keys Once your AI tool is connected to the systeme.io MCP server, you can manage your contacts using simple, natural language prompts. 1. Managing contacts The MCP server allows you to perform basic actions on your contacts directly from the chat. Provide the required details (such as an email address) and specify the action you want to perform. a. Create a contact: You can ask the AI to add a new contact to your list. Example : Create the following contact: John Doe, systemeio.help.demo@gmail.com, (202) 555-0123. b. Update a contact: If you need to change a contact's information, simply provide the contact's email and the new details to the AI. Example: Update contact for systemeio.help.demo@gmail.com, change their name to "Sami" and the phone number to "+12345678." c. List and retrieve contacts: You can use the AI to filter your lists or fetch specific contact details without searching through your dashboard manually. Example: List the last 3 contacts. Or: Find the contact with the email systemeio.help.demo@gmail.com. d. Delete a contact: Instruct the AI to remove a contact from your systeme.io contact list. Example: Remove contact with email systemeio.help.demo@gmail.com. 2. Managing tags Tags help you organize your contacts, and you can manage them completely through the AI chat. a. Create, update, or delete tags: Tell the AI to create a new tag, change an existing tag's name, or delete a tag you no longer need. Example: Create a new tag named "My course". b. List tags: You can ask the AI to retrieve and display a list of all your currently existing tags. Example: List all my tags. c. Assign tags: You can instruct the AI to manage the tags assigned to specific contacts. Example: Assign the tag "My course" to the contact systemeio.help.demo@gmail.com. 3. Contact fields (custom fields) The AI can list your available contact fields and their slugs, allowing you to use them when searching for or updating contacts. Example: List my available contact fields and their slugs. Notes: The MCP server actions described above are available on all systeme.io plans. The AI will require confirmation prompts depending on the platform you use (for example, ChatGPT may ask for permission to run the action before creating or deleting a contact).
